full_prompt_en: A square dark oil portrait depicts a pale theatrical face set against dense black and deep crimson. The head fills the center, cropped closely at the top, and looks almost directly outward with a tired, unwavering expression. Chalk-white paint covers the forehead, cheeks, and chin but retains worn ocher cracks and subtle gray modeling. Around the eye on the viewer's left, a sharply tapered crimson shape rises toward the forehead and descends in a thin point down the cheek. The eyelids sit in dark shadow, making the half-open eyes look inward and heavy. Deep red lips are closed beneath a small, softly modeled nose. A broad rectangular crimson panel hangs in front of the upper right side of the face, hiding part of the forehead and one eye; darker translucent red lies across its lower section. Rounded red forms project from behind the head on the left, while nearly black space encloses the right side. Below the face, an elaborate off-white ruff rises around the neck in thick folded loops. Its cream highlights and brown-gray creases give each fold depth, but the collar dissolves into the dark lower edge. The painted surface is visibly aged and textured, with rubbed passages, hairline cracks, and intermittent scraped marks. Light falls from the front-left, giving the white face and collar a cold glow while the red structures and black background remain heavy. The composition is tightly cropped and nearly symmetrical in its central face, yet the bold crimson interruptions tilt its balance. The overall mood is severe and uncanny, carried by the collision of porcelain-like pale paint, opaque red geometry, and deep shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形深色油画肖像描绘一张苍白的戏剧化面孔，置于浓黑与深红之中。头部占满中央，顶部被紧紧截断，几乎正视观看者，神情疲惫却不移。粉笔白颜料覆盖额头、脸颊与下巴，但保留磨损的赭色裂痕和细微灰色塑形。观看者左侧眼睛周围，一道尖锐收束的深红形状向额头升起，又以细尖延向脸颊。眼睑位于深影里，使半睁的眼睛显得沉重内敛。小而柔和塑形的鼻子下方，深红嘴唇紧闭。一块宽阔的深红矩形垂在面部右上方前景，遮住部分额头和一只眼睛；其下部覆着更深、更半透明的红色。圆润红色形体从头后左侧伸出，右侧则由近黑空间围住。面部下方，华丽的灰白褶领以厚重折环环绕颈部。奶油色高光与棕灰褶缝赋予每道折面深度，但领饰逐渐融入下缘黑暗。绘画表面明显陈旧且富有肌理，有摩擦过的区域、细裂纹和间断刮痕。光从左前方落下，给白色面庞与领饰冷亮光泽，而红色结构和黑背景保持沉重。构图紧密裁切，中央面孔近乎对称，醒目的深红遮挡却使平衡倾斜。整体气氛严峻而奇异，来自瓷质般浅色颜料、不透明红色几何和浓重阴影的碰撞。
style_prompt_en: The oil-painted surface uses a narrow, forceful palette of chalk white, bone cream, oxblood red, ocher wear, and dense black. Pale modeled areas appear almost porcelain-like but are interrupted by cracks, rubbing, and uneven pigment. Broad opaque red planes create hard geometric cuts against more rounded, softly shaded light volumes. Black surrounds and penetrates the image, concentrating attention on a few bright features. Deep creases are rendered with brown-gray shadow and small cream highlights rather than fine uniform outlines. Light arrives from the front and slightly to one side, intensifying the pale area while allowing the periphery to disappear into darkness. The composition compresses a central mass with asymmetric blocks that partly veil it, giving stillness an unsettling tension. Texture alternates between smooth blended modeling and weathered scratches, so the finish feels both theatrical and damaged. The overall effect is austere, intimate, and ominous, with color contrast carrying the drama.
style_prompt_zh: 油画表面使用粉笔白、骨奶油色、暗血红、磨损赭色与浓黑组成狭窄却有力的色盘。浅色塑形区域近似瓷质，却被裂纹、磨擦和不均颜料打断。宽阔不透明红色平面以硬朗几何切口压向更圆润、柔和塑影的亮色体块。黑色从外围围合并穿入图像，使注意力集中在少数明亮部位。深褶缝由棕灰阴影与细小奶油色高光描绘，而非均匀细线。光从正面略偏一侧照来，加强浅色区域，让外围消失在黑暗里。构图把中央团块与部分遮挡它的不对称色块压缩在一起，使静止状态带上不安的张力。肌理在平滑融合的塑形与风化刮痕之间交替，因此表面既有舞台感又显受损。整体效果严峻、亲密且不祥，戏剧性由色彩反差承担。
theme_en: A pale theatrical face framed by red forms and a folded collar
theme_zh: 红色形体与折叠领饰围住的苍白戏剧面庞
name: Michael Hussar
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
